preconditions.description: Attacker must have minter role (either be owner or be set as minter via setMinter function)
Attacker address must not be blacklisted

exploit_hint: As a minter (owner or designated minter), call the mint() function with your address as the recipient and an arbitrary large amount (e.g., type(uint256).max). This will inflate the token supply and give you unlimited tokens that can be transferred or sold, devaluing the token for all other holders.
